name: Love at Furist Bite
source:
I visit my favorite bakery every day, or well... used to. a mysterious fire overtook the establishment. now I'm stuck on a street I haven't even seen before, visiting a pink and lively bakery cleverly named MorningStar soon becomes a part of my daily routine. though the owner seems kind of strange. And their only other worker clearly doesn't fit in. 

Unpack the mysterious that lie underneath this upbeat bakery. try to overcome problems as you make your way through this broken world. learn about your roommates while trying to discover what actually goes on behind closed doors.

[from [url=https://pawfulltrust.itch.io/love-at-furist-bite]itch.io[/url]]
